name: engmentor
description: EngMentor（英师）— Windows 优先的本地桌面英语学习助手。根包只做编排，不发布、不含业务逻辑。

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:py && pnpm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:py: cd services/ai-core && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:py
scripts.typecheck:web: pnpm --filter @engm/desktop run typecheck && pnpm --filter @engm/contracts run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:py && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.test:rust: pnpm run build:web && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:rust
